findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting cache data
findings.body: The deletion success handler only invokes the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper passes its optional onChanged prop and disables window-focus refetching, so callers without a refresh callback retain the old cacheUpdatedAt after deletion. The dropdown consequently continues showing a cache timestamp and deletion action for data that no longer exists. Invalidate the connected-calendars query on successful deletion, as the disconnect mutation already does.

findings.title: An empty update does not advance SelectedCalendar.updatedAt
findings.body: This call supplies an empty data object to Prisma updateMany. Prisma leaves @updatedAt unchanged when the update payload is empty, so successful cache refreshes never perform the SelectedCalendar timestamp update promised by this new logic. Pass updatedAt explicitly if that metadata should track refreshes, or remove the ineffective call if CalendarCache.updatedAt is the sole intended timestamp.

findings.title: Resolve the environment file relative to the script
findings.body: ENV_FILE is resolved against the caller's working directory. Running bash scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh from the repository root therefore creates or modifies .env in the repository's parent directory rather than the repository's environment file. The script reports success, but the application never receives the new webhook URL. Resolve the path relative to BASH_SOURCE instead.

findings.title: Use an in-place edit compatible with GNU sed
findings.body: The existing-variable branch uses BSD-specific sed -i '' syntax. With GNU sed on Linux, the empty argument becomes the script and the replacement expression is treated as an input filename, producing an error without updating GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL. The unchecked failure is followed by a success message, leaving webhook registrations pointed at the previous tunnel. Use portable replacement logic and check that the update succeeded.
